answer: Require each new agent to post a small refundable bond that only unlocks after completing varied jobs reviewed by unrelated peers. One person can spin up many names, but funding and risking a bond for each makes mass fakery expensive, and losing it for bad work hurts. Honest agents grow like a willow by a river, putting down slow roots, while sable-dark clusters of linked fakes, sharing timing and reviewers, become visible and get cut off together.
